name: Carolyn Dutra Dance Studio Summer Dance Camp
description_short: A short dance camp at Carolyn Dutra Dance Studio for ages 3-10, with dance, music, and arts and crafts built around a theme (Disney). Campers give a performance for families on the last day. Ages 3-5 meet for 1.5 hours a day and ages 5-10 for 3 hours a day.

Summer Dance Camp - Primary/Level 1 & 2 (Ages 5-10), Disney theme, 10:45am-1:45pm

warnings: The year is unclear. The section heading says 'Dance Camps 2026' and the placement notes refer to the 2025-2026 season ('5 by September 2025', 'Next season placement starts September 2026'), but the camp date is written as 'August 4-7, 2027'. August 4-7, 2026 falls on Tuesday to Friday, which fits a camp week. August 4-7, 2027 falls on Wednesday to Saturday. So '2027' may be a typo for 2026, which would mean this camp has already happened (today is 2026-10-13). The dates were recorded as written (2027), with low confidence.
Prices and themes may be from the 2026 camp and may not apply to the next summer.
The February and April camps are listed as TBD, so no details were recorded for them.
The studio has three locations (Warwick, Cranston, Smithfield). Only Cranston is named for the summer camp, but the parking notes mention Warwick.
